turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Of course. I'll do the first one so you can see my thinking.
"We stayed in ___ hotel." "Hotel" starts with the sound "h", not a vowel sound, so I use a: We stayed in a hotel.
Rule: a before most sounds, an before a vowel sound.
Right: We ate an egg. Wrong: We ate a egg.

Now try it. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
